articles.author: Jaguar Health, Inc.
articles.headline: Jaguar Health reports debt-for-equity exchanges and cancellation of a secured note
articles.summary: Jaguar discloses issuance of 182,091 shares for a $1,678,320 reduction of a 2021 note and confirms cancellation of a separate 2025 note after a 547,898-share exchange reducing that balance by $5,049,909.26. Debt reduction through share issuance is distinct from cash financing and increases dilution.
